chapter: Western University and Kansas City nightlife
title: Lester Young as a big brother
summary: Lester was kind to Ramey, who gave him his tenor saxophone, and he took up with Countess Johnson.

blocks.x: Well, what was Lester like in those days?
And Ben--Ben Moten. Ben Moten was still there.
Yeah. But Lester, when you first

Well, he was always nice and considerate. In fact, he was like my big brother. In fact That tenor saxophone he had when he was in New York, I gave it to him. That's the one they gave me at the University, that Conn Silver Kahn (phonetic)?

The one that he liked the best of all? I gave that to him. He was very kind, but he was also going with the Countess Johnson, who I worked with later, see? When I started working down there opposite them, on 12th Street, then he started going with the Countess. And so then--
